scientific_question: MECHANISM_INTERVENTION: does the clipping-Jacobian mechanism identified by A0E2 (gain_clip = err_BH_fixed - err_C > 0 under clip=1.0) have intervenable causal evidence? When clipping is fully disabled J_clip = I and BH_fixed and C must degenerate to the same response propagation (up to numerical error). Core prediction: gain_clip > 0 under clip=1.0; gain_clip ~ 0 under no-clip; Delta_clip = mean(gain_clip_clip1) - mean(gain_clip_noclip) > 0.
model_fixed_note: G3 uses the frozen G1a 26.681728M configuration (hidden=512/layers=7/heads=8/kv=4/head_dim=64/intermediate=1664, vocab=6400, seq=128). NOT 100M. Reason: 26M has validated full tangent (G1a STRONG_SCALE_REPLICATION frozen), clip activation ~100% (training 36/36, future first-step 36/36) making it the highest-information condition for a clipping intervention, and compute cost is markedly lower than 100M.

model.intermediate_size_rule: MiniMindConfig default ceil(hidden*pi/64)*64 (same frozen formula as anchor/G1a; NOT hand-picked)
model.identity_check: model config is byte-identical in every field to research/configs/g1a_26m_v01.json model block; runner asserts the measured unique-params count at train time

training.paired_identity_design: same seeds, same dataset order rule (train_batch_seed = train_seed + 1704), same partition, same LR schedule axis as G1a; the ONLY change vs G1a is clipping disabled
training.optimizer: torch.optim.AdamW default family: betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0.01
training.clip_implementation: TRAINING: torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_ is NEVER called in the G3 train loop (genuine disable, recorded per-step as clip_grad_norm_called=false). Preclip grad norm is still measured but does not modify gradients. RESPONSE primitives (frozen run_theta_branch / a0c / a0e2 runners) only implement clipping through g*min(max_norm/(||g||+1e-6),1); for the no-clip condition they receive CLIP_DISABLED_MAX_NORM=1e30, for which the clamp is exactly 1.0 (mathematical identity, gradients bit-unchanged). This sentinel is used ONLY because the frozen response framework has no other code path; it is not used in training.
training.counterfactual_clip_indicator: per optimizer step, record would_clip_threshold_1 = (preclip_grad_norm > 1.0); purely diagnostic, never affects training
training.train_batch_seed_rule: train_seed + 1704 (same frozen derivation rule as v07/G1a)
training.checkpoint_contents: same as G1a plus grad_clip_enabled flag and per-step clip_called/counterfactual records

g3a_operator_control.construction: same baseline trajectory replay (clip=1.0 native); two tangent versions: (A) frozen C with real J_clip (a0e2 runner); (B) C_identity = C with the future-step clip-JVP replaced by identity (h=1 pulse through J_clip unchanged); HVP/AdamW/baseline untouched
g3a_operator_control.requirement: C_identity == BH_fixed within tolerance (max abs gap <= 1e-12); H=1 trivially identical
g3a_operator_control.not_causal_evidence: G3a answers only whether the BH_fixed-vs-C difference comes from the clipping Jacobian operator; it is NOT a no-clip training-regime claim

q_construction.rule: identical to G1a/v07 E3C: per state, probe batch = all 32 partition probe_indices, q = g_probe / ||g_probe|| (global L2)

response_protocol_inheritance.pulse: post-unscale / pre-clip location semantics preserved; under no-clip the frozen branch applies the identity clip so the pulse enters raw gradients
response_protocol_inheritance.epsilon_rule: epsilon = 0.25 * sigma_q over 16 E1 streams (frozen rule)
response_protocol_inheritance.crn: baseline/plus/minus share identical Z_t, batch manifest, RNG stream, LR path
response_protocol_inheritance.hvp: math-SDPA reverse-over-reverse surrogate (same frozen mixed-backend caveat)
response_protocol_inheritance.clip: clip=1.0 reference read from frozen G1a outputs (NOT rerun); no-clip condition via CLIP_DISABLED_MAX_NORM sentinel in frozen primitives

paired_stream_identity.rule: G3 E1/E2 stream seeds reuse the G1a bases (E1 408202601, E2 409202601) with the identical two_level_seed(base, train_seed, state_step, stream_id) derivation, so every future batch/RNG stream is bit-identical to the frozen G1a clip=1.0 condition; paired comparison by (seed, stage, stream, H) is exact by construction
paired_stream_identity.clip_reference_source: outputs/generalization_g1a_26m_v01/results/per_stream.json + mechanism stream JSONs + tangents step traces (frozen, read-only)

main_matrix.note: all four streams computed on every state (FD/B/BH_fixed/C) to demonstrate mechanism collapse, not only C

mechanism_subset.primary: all 36 streams carry BH_fixed; gain decomposition pooled over H>1 cells
mechanism_subset.seed_2042_reference: mirrors G1a mechanism subset for direct comparison
mechanism_subset.identity_requirement: under no-clip, BH_fixed == C at every H (up to fp); under clip=1.0, H=1 identity only

gains.no_sign_presupposition: signed per cell; no requirement that every cell be positive

checks: q strictly same names/shapes as parameters
no-clip: no branch ever reports clipping active (first_clipped false, tangent clip_active false all steps)
no-clip: BH_fixed vs C max abs gap == 0 (bit-identical expected) at all recorded H
training manifest records clip_grad_norm_called=false for every step
smoke_gate.policy: implementation bug => fix + re-smoke with change log; BH/C theory-identity failure under no-clip => CONTRACT_MISMATCH, stop before formal statistics

statistics.interaction: paired by (seed, stage, H) and by (seed, stage, stream, H): Delta_clip = gain_clip_clip1 - gain_clip_noclip; pooled mean, by-H, per-seed, per-stage; hierarchical cluster bootstrap (seed>stage>stream, 20000 resamples, rng seed 20260916) for the mean interaction

MECHANISM_CONFIRMED.cond3_noclip_identity_and_predictive: no-clip BH_fixed and C each pooled R2 >= 0.5 and mean rel err <= 0.5 AND max rel |BH_fixed - C| / |chi_FD| <= 1e-6

verdict_thresholds_frozen.MECHANISM_PARTIAL: cond1 holds AND no-clip gain_clip clearly shrinks (shrink ratio <= 0.5) but cond2 not met, or seed/stage heterogeneity in the interaction
verdict_thresholds_frozen.MECHANISM_NOT_CONFIRMED: closing clipping leaves BH_fixed-vs-C gap comparable to the clip condition (shrink ratio > 0.5), or the operator control cannot attribute the gap to J_clip
verdict_thresholds_frozen.RESOURCE_LIMIT: experiment incomplete due to resource limits (full diagnostics required)
verdict_thresholds_frozen.CONTRACT_MISMATCH: frozen BH/C definitions fail the no-clip theoretical degeneracy (BH_fixed != C beyond tolerance under no-clip)
verdict_thresholds_frozen.note: thresholds frozen here before any G3 result is opened and will not be changed

dynamics_context.usage: context/explanation only; states may NOT be filtered post hoc

resource_rules.gpu: any currently available GPU; record sharing; never kill other workloads
allowed_under_oom: smaller device microbatch with matching accumulation to keep global batch/tokens fixed
forbidden: changing seq len / global batch / H / optimizer / precision semantics
resource_rules.resource_limit_policy: emit RESOURCE_LIMIT with full diagnostics; do NOT silently downscale

scientific_boundaries: G3a operator control is NOT causal training-regime evidence
the causal claim rests on G3b no-clip trajectories
curvature feedback is not claimed to vanish; only the clip-JVP leg is intervened on
no-clip does NOT imply C == FD (finite-epsilon FD nonlinearity remains)
training-dynamics differences (loss/norm) are recorded for explanation only; state selection must not change based on them
clipping-regime cross-scale observations remain observations; no empirical law, no causal attribution beyond G3b
